title: Isao's camera shook near the creature because his mover had no velocity and his panic fled whichever arm was nearest; he now flies as a body
context: Owner, 2026-10-10: 'often when Isao is too close to the enemy, his camera shakes violently, like the 3d model is stuck repeatedly on a wrong path'.
outcome: Root cause from a per-frame trace (0ad1eafb): every frame set his velocity to the wanted one, and the panic fled the nearest low arm, which swapped between two arms nearly as near frame by frame: a 32 m/s zigzag, 56 % of the frames over 60 m/s2 with the creature close (p90 3,600). Now: a carried velocity steered at accel 30 m/s2 (panicAccel 50), the panic flees the weighted sum of the low arms with hysteresis (in at 12 m, out beyond 14 m, 0.25 s dwell), eased hop phases, the bob and facing on damped springs, the ISAO · CAM look target on a critically damped spring. Held close for 20 s: 99.6-99.9 % of frames under 60 m/s2, the look under 360 deg/s throughout (max 143). Side effect: finite acceleration makes him answer a little later, and --boss-bait's keep and speed-band checks fail more often (see 2026-10-11-boss-lab-browser-suite-flakiness).
alternatives: smoothing the drawn pose only: would hide the zigzag while the flight stayed wrong; fixed at the cause first, smoothing added on top
